title: Avocado and Paneer Salad
description: A refreshing salad with creamy paneer and avocado, balanced by nutty flavors. Perfect for a light meal or snack.
instructions: Cut the paneer into small cubes and set aside.
In a pan, lightly toast the nutty granola over low heat.
In a large bowl, combine the diced avocado, sweet peppers, and toasted granola.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Pour the lemon juice mixture over the avocado mixture and toss gently.
Add the paneer cubes to the bowl and toss again to combine.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
